title: Validate flat and nested auth_type payloads in BigQuerySource
answers: Why does BigQuerySource.validate_config check if auth_type is a string or a dict?
How does BigQuery source credential validation handle flat vs nested payload shapes?
What happens if BigQuery source validation ignores bare string auth_type inputs?
body:
BigQuery source credentials can arrive either nested under an auth_type dictionary or flattened at the top level of job_inputs with auth_type as a bare string.
Enforced in products/warehouse_sources/backend/temporal/data_imports/sources/bigquery/source.py:BigQuerySource.validate_config by checking isinstance(auth_type, str) and extracting credentials from job_inputs.
Skipping the bare string check allows sources submitted with top-level credentials to bypass credential validation entirely and save with invalid or missing credentials.
